description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, displaying ten distinct categories represented as slices of varying sizes and colors. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to 'NQ' and accounts for 31.3% of the total. The second largest, an orange slice labeled 'SNLI', represents 15.4%. Following this are a teal slice for 'VITAMINC' at 13.0%, a red slice for 'MULTINLI' at 11.3%, and a greenish-teal slice for 'FEVER' at 16.3%. Smaller segments include 'SUMHUL' (1.6%, light teal), 'SCITAIL' (1.2%, green), 'PUBHEALTH' (0.5%, dark green), 'FACTCC' (2.6%, dark green), 'ANLI' (4.6%, dark green), 'ENTFA' (1.8%, yellow), and 'SCIFACT' (0.1%, dark green). Each slice is clearly labeled with its name and percentage value via a line extending from the edge of the chart. The chart includes a legend that associates each data source with its color, and all percentage values are explicitly shown next to their respective labels. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest blue slice at the top right.
